prompt:

Asset: More Mushrooms HoneyFungus PlantA MATURE UNIT, not a juvenile.
Create one isolated small game sprite matching attached reference 1 exactly in drawing language: simple flat 2D, thick continuous warm dark-brown outlines, two or three solid color planes, slight elevated three-quarter view, no grain or photographic detail. Genuine alpha transparency, no white/black/checkerboard backdrop. Center the entire subject with at least 15% clear margin. No text, faces, poison symbols, props, soil, ground, leaves, logs, box or external cast shadow.
Reference 2 is real Armillaria mellea for species anatomy/colors only. Depict a compact mature tuft of THREE complete honey-yellow mushrooms connected at the stem bases: rounded honey-gold umbrella caps with darker caramel center and a few tiny simple brown scales near the center; pale cream undersides; tan/slightly curved upright stems each with a clearly readable pale ivory skirt-like ring below the cap. Cap of the middle mushroom higher, smaller flanking caps at distinct heights. Draw simplified broad gill planes, not dozens of lines. Ringed honey fungus, NOT ringless Desarmillaria. Keep the unit compact and readable at small size; exactly one natural tuft, no environmental substrate. A is the primary adult silhouette.
